1.1 Small Group · Group 1
items.description: With my small group, I can describe the ways we are all doers of math, and compare my math story with a classmate's — one step at a time, with support.

items.title: 1.1 Small Group · Group 2
items.description: I can describe the ways we are all doers of math, and compare my math story with a classmate's, explain how I can tell, and judge a case I have not seen before.

items.title: 1.1–1.3 Catch-Up
items.description: I can show I am caught up on Lessons 1.1–1.3 by using each lesson's big idea in mixed practice.

items.title: 1.2 Small Group · Group 1
items.description: With my small group, I can make sense of a problem, plan a strategy, and use fractions of a whole number to compare quantities — one step at a time, with support.

items.title: 1.2 Small Group · Group 2
items.description: I can make sense of a problem, plan a strategy, and use fractions of a whole number to compare quantities, explain how I can tell, and judge a case I have not seen before.

items.title: 1.3 Small Group · Group 1
items.description: With my small group, I can represent a real-world situation with a tape diagram or table and use decimal operations to solve it — one step at a time, with support.

items.title: 1.3 Small Group · Group 2
items.description: I can represent a real-world situation with a tape diagram or table and use decimal operations to solve it, explain what each part stands for, and build one for a situation I have not seen before.

items.title: 1.4 Small Group · Group 1
items.description: With my small group, I can construct an argument using equations, drawings, or words, and use volume to defend a recommendation — one step at a time, with support.

items.title: 1.4 Small Group · Group 2
items.description: I can construct an argument using equations, drawings, or words, and use volume to defend a recommendation, explain what each part stands for, and build one for a situation I have not seen before.

items.title: 1.4–1.7 Catch-Up
items.description: I can show I am caught up on Lessons 1.4–1.7 by using each lesson's big idea in mixed practice.

items.title: 1.5 Small Group · Group 1
items.description: With my small group, I can find patterns and pattern rules, use them to make generalizations, and check my solutions with a table of values — one step at a time, with support.

items.title: 1.5 Small Group · Group 2
items.description: I can find patterns and pattern rules, use them to make generalizations, and check my solutions with a table of values, explain why the method works, and use it on a problem I have not seen before.

items.title: 1.6 Small Group · Group 1
items.description: With my small group, I can describe my problem-solving process, name strategies for getting unstuck, and identify the behaviors that make our class a community of math thinkers — one step at a time, with support.

items.title: 1.6 Small Group · Group 2
items.description: I can describe my problem-solving process, name strategies for getting unstuck, and identify the behaviors that make our class a community of math thinkers, explain how I can tell, and judge a case I have not seen before.

items.title: 10.1 Small Group · Group 1
